relationship_to_v0.2.1: New prospective study motivated by the failed v0.2.1 strict factual-equivalence test. v0.2.1 remains unchanged and is not reclassified.
primary_question: Does weak nonlinear action-feature excitation amplify intervention/counterfactual error substantially more than it amplifies on-policy factual error, despite exactly matched raw action mean and covariance?
primary_endpoint: mean across paired runs of log(CF_MSE_low/CF_MSE_high) - log(factual_MSE_low/factual_MSE_high)
primary_success_rule: Lower bound of the stratified paired-bootstrap 95% CI for the mean log amplification must exceed log(2).
secondary_rule: Lower bound of the stratified paired-bootstrap 95% CI for mean log(CF_low/CF_high) must exceed log(1.5).
factual_result_policy: Report factual low/high ratio and CI without a pass/fail equivalence claim.

primary_model.selection_history: Frozen from v0.2.1 DEV using factual validation only; no v0.3 tuning.

dynamics.beta_values_status: Held out from the v0.2.1 primary beta=1.0 confirmation.

evaluation.factual: MSE to noiseless conditional mean on each corresponding behavior distribution
evaluation.counterfactual: MSE to noiseless conditional mean on a common balanced four-corner action distribution

bootstrap.method: stratified paired percentile bootstrap; resample paired runs within each beta stratum so each beta remains equally weighted

mechanistic_calibration.status: registered calibration, not the primary neural endpoint
mechanistic_calibration.purpose: Verify the finite-sample feature-conditioning mechanism when the correct nonlinear feature is supplied explicitly.

nonclaims: No factual-equivalence claim for the neural model.
No claim that raw action covariance is generally sufficient or useless.
No claim that counterfactual MSE maps proportionally to planning regret.
No reclassification of v0.2.1 as successful confirmation.
